title: The Heat is Killing Me
synopsis: In summertime in China the temperature in many cities reaches over 35 degrees celsius. Here we learn some clever methods for keeping cool.

fullText.simplified:
热死了

    夏日炎炎，中国各大城市迎来了一年之中最热的时候，很多地方的气温都达到了35度以上。大家纷纷在微信朋友圈上晒自己城市的气温，旁边毫无例外地配上一句：热死了！
    有空调的人们当然是开空调，或者去大商场、图书馆等有空调的地方避暑。没有空调的人们怎么办呢？他们纷纷想出奇招来降温。有的人跑到游泳池里打麻将；有的人因为宿舍里没空调睡不着，于是跑到天台上睡；有的人抱着从冰箱里取出来的西瓜入睡；有的人把脚放到冰水里降温……
    这是物理降温，还有些人想出了心理降温的妙招。比如，网上推荐的心理降温的妙招是这样的：在感觉热的时候，想想自己的月收入，心里凉半截；想想自己的岁数，再想想自己还是单身狗，后背肯定嗖嗖地冒冷风；如果还没有降温，再去查询一下银行卡的余额……好了，你现在还热吗？
    各种各样的降温方式，无奇不有。难怪很多网友直呼：“打败我的不是天真，是天真热。”
fullText.traditional:
熱死了

    夏日炎炎，中國各大城市迎來了一年之中最熱的時候，很多地方的氣溫都達到了35度以上。大家紛紛在微信朋友圈上曬自己城市的氣溫，旁邊毫無例外地配上一句：熱死了！
    有空調的人們當然是開空調，或者去大商場、圖書館等有空調的地方避暑。沒有空調的人們怎麼辦呢？他們紛紛想出奇招來降溫。有的人跑到游泳池裡打麻將；有的人因為宿舍裡沒空調睡不著，於是跑到天台上睡；有的人抱著從冰箱裡取出來的西瓜入睡；有的人把腳放到冰水裡降溫……
    這是物理降溫，還有些人想出了心理降溫的妙招。比如，網上推薦的心理降溫的妙招是這樣的：在感覺熱的時候，想想自己的月收入，心裡涼半截；想想自己的歲數，再想想自己還是單身狗，後背肯定嗖嗖地冒冷風；如果還沒有降溫，再去查詢一下銀行卡的餘額……好了，你現在還熱嗎？
    各種各樣的降溫方式，無奇不有。難怪很多網友直呼：“打敗我的不是天真，是天真熱。”

raw.synopsis: In summertime in China the temperature in many cities reaches over 35 degrees celsius. Here we learn some clever methods for keeping cool.
sentence_translations: The Heat is Killing Me
It's scorching summertime and China's large cities are facing the hottest time of the year.
Many areas have temperatures over 35 degrees celsius.
On after another, everyone shares their city's temperature on the WeChat timeline.
Next to the temperature they then without exception add: “The heat is killing me!”
Those who have air conditioners of course use them.
Or they will go to a large shopping mall, library or other place with air conditioning to avoid the heat.
So what can people who do not have air conditioners do?
One after another they come up with unusual tricks to lower the temperature.
Some people get into the pool to play mahjong.
Others who cannot sleep because the dormitory is not air conditioned, instead go to sleep on the rooftop.
Others go to sleep hugging a watermelon taken out of the refrigerator.
Yet others put their feet in ice water to cool down.
These all physically lower the temperature, but others have come up clever methods to cool down mentally.
For example, here are some clever tricks to mentally lower the temperature suggested online:
When you think it's hot, think about your monthly salary and half your heart will get cold.
Think about your age and the fact that you are still single, and you will surely feel a cool wind flowing from your back.
If you are still hot, go check the balance on your bank account.
All right, are you still feeling hot?
There are so many different methods to cool down, and nothing is too bizarre.
No wonder a lot of netizens say: “What defeated me was not my naivety, it was that the sky is really hot”
